title: Paste Any AI's Answer, Mini Elvarika Still Gets It | vitalii.no
description:
Every lesson in a small language-learning app used to come from one shared AI subscription call. That subscription's quota was shared with every other project on the same account, so a busy day writing lessons could stall unrelated work elsewhere.

Now a button in the app copies a strictly-formatted lesson prompt, ready to paste into any outside AI chat instead of the built-in one. The reply gets pasted back into the app and parsed directly into vocabulary words and dialogue lines, not dumped in as generic document text the way a random paste used to be. A Cloudflare Worker routes the pasted answer into the same lesson structure the app already understands.

A simple check keeps it honest: the app only accepts the pasted answer once it counts at least 3 real parsed lines in the expected format. Anything thinner falls back safely to plain document mode instead of producing a broken lesson.
